title: After Years of Creating Superheroes, I Turned Them Into a Game
author: Dersuss
selftext:
I've spent the last few years creating my own superhero universe, writing stories, developing characters, and working on comics.

These last few months, I decided to try turning it into a video game!

It's called *Crisis in CapeTown*, and the best way I can describe it is **Dispatch meets Vampire Survivors, with a little Hades thrown in.**

I've been building it in Godot using Claude Code, ChatGPT, PixelLab, and some purchased assets.

My background is a bit of a mixed bag. I've worked in comedy, livestreaming, and podcast production, and I also went through a full-stack programming bootcamp. So I'm no stranger to learning new tools, and while I can technically code, I wouldn't exactly call myself a great programmer. I've always been more interested in bringing ideas to life.

It's been a pretty wild time (especially the last month) of learning, experimenting, breaking things, and being pleasantly surprised. 

https://reddit.com/link/1x14dj6/video/hwuonse2hbuh1/player

There's still a ton I want to do, but I'm pretty excited about how it's coming together.

I'm working on getting the Steam page up and running and planning to start making devlogs soon. In the meantime, I just wanted to share some of the progress so far!

Would love to hear what you guys think!
